name: Topographic illumination and horizon-shadow verification
purpose: Verify facet/ray occlusion and terrain horizon classification independently of observational scoring.
production_capability: Triangulated-surface ray tracing, terrain shadow attributes, and uniform apparent-disc Earth-eclipse overlap.
configuration: Deterministic horizontal facet and vertical-ridge fixture; 1 micrometre ray-origin offset declared by the fixture.
independent_reference: Closed-form line/plane intersection and facet-normal sign.
frame_time_convention: One declared lunar body-fixed frame and fixed Sun vector/epoch.
procedure: Call the production BVH ray service for overhead, single-ridge, back-facing, and exact ridge-distance cases; call the production apparent-disc overlap kernel for disjoint, total, contained, and partial equal-radius circles.
acceptance_criteria: All three terrain classifications exact, ridge intersection distance within 1e-14 relative, and every closed-form circle-overlap branch within 1e-14 relative.
expected_pass_result: Production terrain shadowing is geometrically correct and independently classified.
data_hashes: none; I15, not U09, owns independent D02 scoring
status_semantics: PASS verifies the production terrain-ray kernel only; it is not D02 observational validation or linked I15 wiring.
